tagline: NONPROFIT FINANCE  ·  BUDGETING & FORECASTING  ·  AUDIT & FORM 990  ·  RESTRICTED FUNDS  ·  FINANCE TEAM LEADERSHIP
profile: Nonprofit finance executive who builds the systems, controls, and teams that let mission-driven organizations move resources with confidence. Leads annual operating and program budgets, multi-year forecasting, treasury, and reserves strategy; directs audit coordination and readiness; and compiles Form 990 returns for multiple nonprofits as an IRS-registered preparer with an active PTIN. Manages grant and restricted-fund accounting with monthly reconciliation and funder reporting, and partners with CEOs, Boards, and Finance and Audit Committees on planning, risk, and resource allocation. Reversed a $1M operating deficit into a 13% surplus and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings. Leads and develops finance teams, including 12 direct reports across finance, grant stewardship, and operations, with a commitment to equity-centered, community-accountable organizations.

bullets.text: Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Oversee payroll, AP, AR, vendor payments, invoicing, bank reconciliations, and monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for boards and funders.
Compile Form 990 returns for multiple nonprofits and prepare business and individual tax filings, including state and local returns; IRS-registered preparer with an active PTIN.
Lead annual audit coordination and readiness testing for workforce development, healthcare, and smaller 501(c)(3) organizations.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Identified and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis and correction of reporting deficiencies.

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development & Social Ventures

bullets.text: Managed multiple program budgets with monthly reconciliation and quarterly performance tracking; monitored restricted and unrestricted cash flow.
Held full P&L accountability for an $80M portfolio; led financial and operational oversight of a 140-person, multi-program division.
Reversed a $1M annual operating deficit and delivered a 13% operating surplus through cost restructuring, financial controls, and revenue optimization.
Partnered with the CEO and Board on long-range planning, risk management, and organizational growth strategy.
Led 12 direct reports across finance, grant stewardship, and operations through weekly team meetings, individual check-ins, and recurring financial reviews.
Negotiated and structured $10M+ in new government, institutional, and corporate contracts.
Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts.
Implemented a redesigned ERP-based warehouse management system, improving processing efficiency 60% and data visibility.
Renegotiated vendor and logistics agreements, reducing costs 35% and improving margins.
Served as financial architect for a $200M national banking-development initiative, supporting capital planning and financial structuring.
Developed operational and performance-improvement strategies for $50M+ organizations and major brands.
Built accounting, governance, and operational infrastructure for an international NGO serving children in Haiti.
Founded and scaled a multi-location business from a $5K investment to a $1M enterprise; delivered 33% YoY revenue growth and an 11% margin improvement.
Built HR, payroll, benefits, and training infrastructure for a team that grew from 4 to 60 full-time employees.
